evidence.detail: Rows ac1/no-section (a fixture installation folder on disk with settings and no space section, read through the one installation reader: not refused, reads {present: false, enabled: false}, no refusal line) and ac1/no-installation (no folder at all reads the same). Green: proof/VELDO-0296/suite-green.txt.
Falsifier space296-no-section-refused (an installation without the section refused): ac1/no-section and ac1/no-installation red; noop copy green. proof/VELDO-0296/mutations.txt.

Rows ac2/missing-by-name (each of the nine keys and seven nested keys left out, refused installation_missing:space.<key>; an empty section refused), ac2/missing-floor (the floor key left out of a pool, from disk and from a given section), ac2/malformed-by-name (29 malformed values, an empty engines list among them, and 5 unknown keys refused installation_invalid:<key>), ac2/logged (one line with key and reason missing, malformed or unknown; never the value; a section that is not a mapping, space: on, read from disk gets the section's own line, refused space (malformed), once).
The from-disk checks of ac2/missing-by-name, ac2/missing-floor and ac2/malformed-by-name, and reader/full-section (the whole fixture section read back from installation.yaml).

Falsifier space296-floor-built-in (a missing floor given the value 0): ac2/missing-floor red (ac2/logged and ac2/malformed-by-name red with it); noop green. Review finding 2: review-space-on-line-not-written (the space: on refusal line not written): ac2/logged red, alone; noop green.

Ten rows, one per entry of the fixture's protect list read back from disk, each checked on both engine contexts (default and desktop-linux): ac3/engine-image-folder, ac3/repository-folder, ac3/volume-pattern, ac3/container-pattern, ac3/image-pattern, ac3/network-pattern, ac3/compose-project-one, ac3/compose-project-two, ac3/image-name-one, ac3/image-name-two; ac3/whole-list (ten entries per context and nothing else, no entry without an engine); ac3/empty-engines (review finding 1: engines naming none refused installation_invalid:space.engines from a given section and from disk, logged malformed, so the protect list is never in force on no engine).

Each of the ten entries removed in turn from what the reader returns: that entry's row red every time (with ac3/whole-list and reader/full-section), no other entry row red. The network case is registered as space296-protect-entry-removed; noop green. Review finding 1: registered falsifier space296-empty-engines-accepted (an empty engines list accepted): ac3/empty-engines red (ac2/malformed-by-name with it); noop green. The ten per-entry runs were made at the build commit and not repeated for the review fix.

Rows ac4/no-mode-key (the reader's key list and its answer carry no mode) and ac4/mode-refused (mode: act and mode: report in a given section refused installation_invalid:space.mode, logged as unknown).
ac4/mode-refused from disk: installation.yaml with mode: act in the space section is refused by name.
Falsifier space296-mode-accepted-ignored (a mode key accepted and ignored): ac4/mode-refused red, alone; noop green.

assumptions: Key spellings (time_zone, scratch_roots with roots and session_pattern, build_roots, plain_repositories with repository and worktree_root, client_accounts, protect with paths, volumes, containers, images, networks, compose_projects; pools with floor and needs per station build, review, gate) are this ticket's reading of design 6.8, which names the keys in words.
An unknown key is refused as installation_invalid:<key>, as the installation reader already refuses an unknown top-level key.
docs/installation.md does not yet describe the space section: it is outside this ticket's footprint (documents are VELDO-0322).
Name patterns and image names are returned as written; matching them against Docker objects is VELDO-0341.
review_fix: Review verdict FIX, two findings, fixed in the commit that carries this manifest (the commit field names the build commit). 1: an engines list naming none is refused as installation_invalid:space.engines. 2: the refusal of a section that is not a mapping writes the space section's own log line.
rollback: Revert the change. No installation is read for a space section, which is the same as space management off.
